E1.evidence: Reporter gives reproduction steps ("Create a controller with `controller_interface::interface_configuration_type::ALL` as type of the command interface configuration (and empty names)" / "Try to switch to another controller that has explicit command interfaces set") and the log "[gazebo-11] [WARN] [controller_manager]: Unable to activate controller 'joint_trajectory_controller' since the command interface 'LF_HAA/position' is currently claimed by another controller."; maintainer: "you have a point that it should never fail"; fix #2856 "Fixes https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/issues/2846".

E2.interface_kind: library API (controller plugin interface configuration) and exclusive resource (command interfaces)
E2.evidence: Host framework (controller_manager) and a controller plugin are separate units. The plugin declares its command interfaces through command_interface_configuration() as type ALL with empty names; the host's early availability check (added by #2760, backported to jazzy by #2772) builds the set of interfaces freed by deactivating controllers from `controller_it->c->command_interface_configuration().names`, so an ALL-type controller frees nothing in that check. The declaration crossing the plugin-host boundary is read under a different convention; with an INDIVIDUAL-type plugin the switch succeeds. The resolving edit (#2856/#2858) is inside controller_manager and makes it use `controller_it->info.claimed_interfaces` when the type is not INDIVIDUAL. Not wiring, build, or firmware.

E3.evidence: PAIR: the plugin's declared interface configuration is consumed by the controller_manager's switch availability check. The failure was observed while switching from the ALL-type controller (deactivated) to joint_trajectory_controller (activated).

E4.evidence: Observed refusal of the switch: "[controller_switch_manager-5] [WARN] [controller_switch_manager]: [_safely_switch_controllers_callback]: Switching controllers failed: Failed to switch controllers to ['joint_trajectory_controller']" (https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/issues/2846).

units.name: reporter_all_command_interfaces_controller
units.revision_basis: The reporter's own controller is not public; it is described only by the reporter's statements of its command interface configuration (artifact section [[reporter_all_command_interfaces_controller@as-reported-2025-11]]). The resolution does not change it.

failed_conditions.quote: There, the `future_available_command_interfaces` are based on the names in the command interface configuration, although these are empty in case of the `ALL` interface configuration type, and therefore the switch fails

loudness_evidence: The controller_manager's resource-claim check refuses the activation: "[gazebo-11] [WARN] [controller_manager]: Unable to activate controller 'joint_trajectory_controller' since the command interface 'LF_HAA/position' is currently claimed by another controller." (https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/issues/2846).

resolution.summary: In ControllerManager::check_for_interfaces_availability_to_activate, take the deactivating controller's interfaces from `cmd_itf_cfg.names` only for INDIVIDUAL configurations and from `controller_it->info.claimed_interfaces` otherwise (ros2_control #2856 on master, #2858 jazzy, #2859 kilted).
resolution.evidence: #2856 adds test switch_controller_test_two_controllers_using_all_interface in which a TestController configured `{controller_interface::interface_configuration_type::ALL, {}}` is deactivated while an INDIVIDUAL TestController is activated and the switch returns OK; this is the fix shown working with a test peer, not with the reporter's controller. The reporter did not confirm.

notes: Composition choice: the failure was observed while switching from the reporter's ALL-type controller to joint_trajectory_controller (a SWITCH between two controllers under controller_manager). The specified composition is the plugin-host pair (controller_manager <-> ALL-type controller) because the mismatch (reading `.names` of an ALL-type InterfaceConfiguration) sits on that boundary and the resolving edit is in controller_manager; a controller<->controller SWITCH composition would have neither unit changed by the fix. The runtime's refusal is an exclusive-resource claim error, so exclusive_resource_conflict is the symptom-level class; representation_convention was chosen for the condition on this boundary. The reporter adds that "This reliance on `command_interface_configuration().names` is present in other places of the codebase as well" (e.g. other `.names` uses in controller_manager.cpp at 4.39.2); the fix only changes the deactivation branch of this check. api: element names use the C++ qualified names declared in controller_interface/controller_interface_base.hpp (controller_interface package, same repository as controller_manager). The interface name LF_HAA/position comes from the reporter's log. The regression was introduced by ros2_control#2760 (master f8903b3f, 2025-11-03).
